other_failure_modes.name: Feature Leakage Before Splitting
other_failure_modes.description: Applying dataset-wide operations like frequency encoding and group aggregations on the combined train and test sets leaks the test feature distributions into the training data.

other_failure_modes.name: Improper Categorical Handling in Neural Network
other_failure_modes.description: Categorical variables are label-encoded into integers, standardized via StandardScaler, and fed into a dense neural network. This falsely imposes an ordinal relationship on nominal categories; embeddings or one-hot encoding should be used.

summary: The solution implements a strong pipeline with domain-specific feature engineering, chronological splitting, and a blended ensemble of gradient boosters and a neural network. However, it suffers from data leakage by fitting a LabelEncoder and computing group/frequency features on the combined train and test sets. Additionally, it reuses the same validation set for both early stopping and ensemble weight optimization, and improperly treats label-encoded categorical variables as continuous numerical features in the neural network.
